catalogue.name: The Tide
catalogue.readme:
Force generation

The lists are divided into three unit categories; Command, Core and Special. When generating forces players must include:
● One (1) Command entry
● Max one (1) Special entry for each Core entry
● Max two (2) upgrades per full 300 points in their force. (Unless otherwise specified, a unit may only take an upgrade once).

Players get 1 Faction Point per full 300 points in their force, and can spend them during force generation to exceed the limits above - one (1) FP lets you take:
● One (1) additional Command entry, (to a maximum of two (2))
● One (1) extra Special entry 
● Two (2) additional upgrades

Cost types:
p: Points
U: Upgrades
FP: Faction Points

sharedRules.name: High Tide
sharedRules.description:
Spend one (1) Faction Point:
● Saturate the air: 1 enemy Aircraft or VTOL vehicle rolls on the damage table with -3, non- vehicle Aircraft or VTOL unit takes a dangerous terrain test.
● Change the land: use before game: place one (1) Infestation tower terrain token anywhere on the board further than 9” from the enemy board edge. It has Inflict Defence(-1) (6”) and Scanner(12”) (does not stack).
● Unceasing Advance: use when an enemy unit within 2” of one of your units makes a withdrawal move or is wiped out with CC attacks. Your unit may make a 6” move.

sharedRules.name: One Mind
sharedRules.description:
All regular units in this faction have Fanatic. All Massive units have Fanatic(optional).
Tide units may only use Tide transports.
